title: GPO Studio test platform registry v1
description: The machine-readable registry of test platforms (hosts, tools, lanes) that remediation scenarios execute against. Host and tool rows extend docs/plan-033/environment-spec.md; a platform is claimable for certification evidence only when its status is frozen. Lane rows bind a Plan 033 work package to the hosts, tools, oracle, and boundary set its evidence requires.

status.description: frozen = appears in environment-spec.md supported builds; pending-qualification = needed by scenarios but not yet qualified

qualifying_run.description: Run id of the evidence run that qualified this host, as cited in the Qualified environments table of environment-spec.md. Required when status is frozen and forbidden otherwise: a frozen claim must name the evidence that earned it, and a registry that cannot be mechanically reconciled with the spec drifts silently (this field exists because it did).

snapshot_required.description: True when scenarios on this host mutate endpoint state and must run on a restorable snapshot

frozen_version.description: Version string frozen in environment-spec.md; absent for studio-harness rows, which are commit-bound instead

status.description: frozen = qualified and pinned; pending-qualification = a lane needs it and it has not been qualified; not-used = it was carried as a requirement and the lane turned out not to need it. The third value exists because the registry could previously only say 'qualified' or 'not yet', which forced a tool whose requirement had evaporated to be either misdescribed or deleted -- and deleting it loses the record that the gate it stood for was closed rather than dropped.

oracle.description: The independent Windows observation that decides the lane, per boundary-matrix.md assertion rule 1

status.description: certified = clean-tree pass recorded; partial = some tranches certified; defined = corpus/platform exist, no oracle pass yet
